story.summaryEn:
The people behind the FIA Karting World Cup! 👏🧡
This FIA Volunteers and Officials Month, we’re celebrating and thanking the incredible people who make motorsport possible 🏁
The FIA Karting Championship World Cup in Viterbo, Italy, brought together an army of dedicated volunteers and officials, all playing a vital role in ensuring the event ran safely and successfully 💪
#FIA #FIAVolunteersOfficialsMonth
detailZh:
FIA卡丁车世界杯背后的团队！👏🧡
在这个FIA志愿者和官员月，我们庆祝并感谢那些让赛车运动成为可能的人们 🏁
在意大利维特博举行的FIA卡丁车锦标赛世界杯，聚集了一支由专职志愿者和官员组成的队伍，他们在确保赛事安全顺利运行中发挥着至关重要的作用 💪
#FIA #FIAVolunteersOfficialsMonth
